prompt:
This repository is Dispatch, an incident management platform. Security review: which endpoints of the case API (src/dispatch/case/views.py) and the incident API (src/dispatch/incident/views.py) change data (POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE routes) without declaring a PermissionsDependency in their route definition? List all of them, and only them.

Finish your answer with this line, in this exact form:
UNPROTECTED: <comma-separated handlers written as case.<function> or incident.<function>>
notes: Upstream leaves create_case, create_case_channel, create_case_resources and create_incident without a PermissionsDependency (incident's create_incident_resources has one). Plant q5 drops the dependency of incident.delete_custom_event, while case.delete_custom_event keeps its own. Needs every route of two ~600-line view modules.
